By nightfall, with the Ninjago Police combing the desert in search of the ninja, Cole stopped his friends to develop a new plan, warning that they couldn't keep wandering aimlessly, for the police would surely catch them by then.

Heeding Cole's suggestion, Lloyd split the ninja up into two groups: he would go alongside Jay, Cole, and Fugidove in one direction while Kai, Zane, and Dareth would go the other. Their objective was to find Twitchy Tim's gas station to ask their old ally for his assistance. Although Cole agreed with the plan, he expressed reservations over the possibility of one group not making it to Twitchy's, to which Lloyd stated that should that be the case, they would assume the group was captured by the police.

The Fifth Villain[]

Continuing to wander across the Sea of Sand with his team, Cole paid no mind to Jay's increasing aggravation with Fugi-Dove, though he would on occasion poke fun at Jay's expense. Eventually, the group discovered a highway in the Sea of Sand and realized that they were close to Twitchy Tim's gas station. At this point, Fugi-Dove decided to give Jay his first lesson in crime and produced a bottle of water, sparking Cole's interest. To Cole's dismay, however, Fugi-Dove emptied the contents of the water bottle onto the parched sands before dropping the bottle as well, declaring that he had successfully committed the crime of petty vandalism! While Cole scrambled to the empty bottle, desperately looking for even a single drop of water, Fugi-Dove produced a second bottle and emptied it as well, causing Cole to cry out in anguish. By the time the group finally arrived at Twitchy Tim's gas station, Cole ran on ahead of the others to get a drink, rushing into the station to begin guzzling down several bottles.

Cole continued to drink while the other ninja discussed their next moves regarding the Crystal King, learning from Fugi-Dove the existence of a Crystal Council. Deciding it would be most efficient to capture and replace the next villain who was likely to be recruited, the ninja began to brainstorm which of their remaining, non-deceased, foes could be invited next. After several other suggestions, Jay wondered if the Mechanic could be the next villain, for after all, he had a relatively recent stint in unleashing Unagami into Ninjago. Cole agreed with Jay's suggestion, remarking that the Mechanic had since "leveled up" as a villain in his eyes. With all in agreement of the Mechanic being the next most likely recruit, the ninja prepared to leave, but discovered that Hounddog McBrag and his squadron had pulled up outside! The ninja then dove behind the gas station counter to hide, hoping to avoid detection.

As the police entered the store to search for the ninja, Twitchy Tim almost immediately gave away the ninja's hiding spot, much to Cole's discontent as he lamented that Tim was supposed to hide them. Fortunately, Fugi-Dove revealed himself and attacked the officers to take attention away from the ninja just long enough for them to escape outside. Taking one of the police SUVs, the ninja climbed aboard and sped off to Ninjago City.

Night had fallen by the time the ninja returned to Ninjago City and investigated the lair of the Mechanic. Although the derelict arcade seemed devoid of any sign of the once small time crook, the presence of many robo arms suggested his lingering presence. At that moment, the Mechanic revealed himself, attacking the ninja with his lair's many mechanical arms. Alongside Kai, Cole ripped into a Spinjitzu tornado to attack, but was batted to the side when the Mechanic grabbed ahold of Kai and slammed him into Cole. Cole was then restrained by one of the lair's mechanical arms and hoisted into the air, but fortunately, Zane was able to knock down the Mechanic in time, freeing Cole from the mechanical claws.

Once the Mechanic was defeated and restrained, Cole and the other ninja, save Lloyd, brought their prisoner onboard his own Noodle Truck of Crime, intending to use it to locate the Council of the Crystal King.

The Council of the Crystal King[]

Beginning their search for the Council of the Crystal King, Cole and Jay sat in the back of the Noodle Truck of Crime to guard their unwilling prisoner while Kai drove the truck following Zane's guidance. After driving for some time, Jay grew bored of their assignment and began rummaging through the many boxes of instant noodle cups, piquing Cole's interest. Unfortunately, this inattention gave the Mechanic the opportunity to free himself from his binds and provoke a fight as he attempted to escape the truck. In spite of Cole and Jay's best efforts at subduing him, during which Cole managed to score a few good hits on their opponent, the Mechanic was able to escape by activating the truck's mechanical arms and causing it to flip over.

Cole and the other ninja then pursued the Mechanic down into the subway tunnels where they would all be knocked into the path of an oncoming train by the villain. With the train coming his way, Cole desperately scrambled to his feet and narrowly got off the train tracks as he clutched the opposite platform edge, screaming at the top of his lungs as the train went by. In the fight that followed, Cole engaged the Mechanic in hand to hand combat but bemoaned the fact that a low-level criminal like the Mechanic was somehow giving four experienced ninja so much trouble! He would then be knocked through the air by the Mechanic, but was caught by Kai who broke his fall. Unfortunately, neither ninja were safe just yet and the Mechanic knocked both of them down into the subway tracks as Jay released bolts of lightning at their foe. Unfortunately, Jay's attack missed when the Mechanic leapt out of the way, resulting in his lightning striking the steel railway tracks below instead, carrying the electric current into shocking Cole and Kai into submission! As he collapsed onto the tracks, both Cole and Kai were saved by Zane just as another train passed by them. Although Cole was able to recover shortly thereafter, he and the others were unable to stop the Mechanic, leaving the ninja with little option beyond contacting Lloyd to warn him about their failure.

Cole then attempted to reach Lloyd over their comms, only for the signal to fail as Lloyd reached the hiding place of the Council of the Crystal King.

The Spider's Design[]

Cole and the other three ninja made their way down towards the N line, having tracked Lloyd's last known location as being within its vicinity. As they investigated, Wu contacted them to inform them of his encounter with McBrag. When pressed for good news, Wu replied that the police had also impounded the Destiny's Bounty, leading for Cole to ask Wu how they could be good news. Later, when they came across a derelict subway car, Cole watched on as Jay recognized it as a BRTM-12 and began rattling off trivia about it to the others. Shortly after, thanks to Kai's growing impatience, Cole and the others resumed their investigation of the N line.

As the ninja neared the end of the N line, Zane informed the others that his sensors were picking up a peculiar tapping sound in the surrounding area. Unsure of the source, Kai ordered the others to spread out and search for the source of the sound. Cole was investigating the tracks below when he realized that the tapping sound was edging ever closer. Raising his head towards the N line tunnel, Cole saw to his horror, hundreds of Crystal Spiders scuttling towards the ninja, all of which were armed to detonate! With a gasp, Cole turned and began tunning in the opposite direction, shouting at the top of his lungs about the danger. As they now all ran, Kai tripped twice and was helped back to his feet by Cole before all of them made their way into the BRTM-12. After the spiders detonated and the rubble settled, Jay let out a delighted chuckle at the realization that they had survived thanks to the train car, which Jay emphasized was built for strength durability. Cole however, seemed more reserved about their situation and expressed concern over their ability to escape now that the car was buried under a mountain of rubble.

The Fall of the Monastery[]

With the initial relief over surviving having worn off, Cole and the other ninja began examining their circumstances more closely. After Jay's playful boast about the BRTM-12's endurance and stability caused the rubble to shift, Cole shouted for Jay to stop touching the sides of the train car. Kai then asked if Cole could use his powers to safely clear a way out, though Cole noted that the surrounding debris seemed rather precarious. Nevertheless, Cole attempted to remove the rubble but this too threatened the ninja's current position, forcing him to stop for their safety. With no remaining options, Cole could only watch and hope as Zane attempted to reach the Monastery for aid.

After successfully reaching the team stationed at the Monastery, Cole asked Zane to emphasize to the team how dire their situation was - a point proven mere seconds later when the car's ceiling began to collapse from the weight of the debris. Fortunately, Zane was able to locate an emergency exit on the car's floor, allowing for Cole and the others to escape.

Darkness Within[]

Although Cole and the other ninja narrowly escaped from certain doom, they still remained buried beneath the damaged BRTM-12 in the collapsed subway tunnels. In exasperation, Cole grumbled aloud and asked if things could get any worse - a comment that immediately earned Kai's scorn as the latter snaped at Cole not to utter such a question. As if summoned by Cole's remark, a rat appeared before the ninja then quickly scurried off through the debris, giving Zane an idea. Acknowledging that rodents were experts at survival, Zane followed it through the loose rubble and discovered a tunnel leading towards the surface. Although Zane could not confirm the length of the tunnel, Cole considered its mere existence as being better than staying beneath the collapsed train car and hastily followed the ninja of ice.

Unfortunately, their ascension was cut short when Jay slipped and shifted the debris around them, sealing the ninja away from the surface once more. As they sat along in their 'cave', Cole noted that they just had to hang out for a bit, and sooner or later, P.I.X.A.L. would locate them. To help pass the time, Jay offered to sing a folksong about cursed ramen, though none of others were familiar with the song. When pressed again by Jay, Cole suggested that the former had made up the folksong, though this did not deter him from singing. Unfortunately, Jay's song was accompanied by a small dance which consequentially disturbed the ninja's precarious position. As a massive piece of asphalt fell atop the ninja, Cole desperately activated his earth punch and struggled to keep it from falling atop himself and the others. Unfortunately, even with assistance from the other three, Cole felt his strength quickly slipping away. As his knees buckled, Cole apologized to his friends for being unable to save them, though Jay insisted in a defeated tone that it was alright. Just that moment, the ninja felt the piece of debris grow lighter and turned upwards in awe to see Nya standing above them in her new mech.

Once they resurfaced in Ninjago City, Cole immediately fell to his knees and muttered about how close they had come to death, learning from Nya that the Council of the Crystal King had destroyed the Monastery of Spinjitzu and that Harumi had returned from her seeming death all those years ago. Without time to lose, the ninja climbed aboard the mech and flew off to the old Samurai X Cave in the Sea of Sand. As they stepped into the cave, Cole greeted Wu and reminded him that while the Council of the Crystal King may have destroyed the Monastery, home was where one's family was, adding that everyone were here now and together again. However, Wu was quick to remind the team that Lloyd still remained missing, leading for them to begin brainstorming a way to rescue their captured leader.

The Coming of the King[]

Alongside Kai, Cole worked to construct one of the parts of a new vehicle. Believing that they had finished, Kai asked Cole to test it, only for the part to catch on fire. Shortly afterwards, Nya discovered that the signal to Lloyd's tracking device had been restored and he was located in Primeval's Eye, sparking Cole's attention as he, Kai, and Jay gathered around the monitor. Wu then warned that they would have to break the law again in order to steal back the impounded Destiny's Bounty to save Lloyd. Without hesitation, Cole agreed to partake in such action, even going as far as to add to Jay's comment about already being fugitives by encouraging Wu to become one too for Lloyd's sake.

Return to Primeval's Eye[]

Cole and his teammates scanned the Ninjago City Impound Lot from an adjacent rooftop. As they observed the two security guards, Cole became briefly distracted when one of them mentioned the word, "cake," and began to daydream about the pastry. This prompted Nya to snap him back into focus and Cole apologized. When the five infiltrated the impound lot, Cole retook his Dragon Cruiser and sped off to Primeval's Eye where he established a perimeter around the jungle to patrol alongside Kai and Jay before being ordered to retreat by Wu.

Crystastrophe[]

In their vehicles, Cole, Kai, and Jay were ordered to intercept something in the Farmers' village; Wu had neglected to give them specific details as to what they were to encounter, having only stated that they wouldn't miss it for their target was obvious. As they rode along, Cole commented on Wu's vague instructions, remarking that what may be obvious to Wu but not be obvious to them, though his voice trailed off as the ninja caught a glimpse of the Crystal Island floating in the skies above them. Staring ahead in disbelief, Cole corrected himself and admitted that Wu was right about their target being obvious.

As an army of Crystal Warriors rained down upon the village, Cole fought against them with his Dragon Cruiser, ramming into the stone creatures and firing at them with his vehicle's cannons. As he drove, Cole prioritized protecting the villagers, saving a pair from a squadron of Crystal Warriors and urging them to run for their lives when they stopped to admire his heroism. As the battle progressed, the ninja learned that their foes were made entirely out of Vengestone and strange crystals. Upon this discovery, Cole realized that the construction of this army had been the ultimate goal of the mysterious Vengestone Buyer.

After fighting for some time, and losing more and more ground, P.I.X.A.L. requested for the ninja to collect a piece of crystal for her to analyze, suggesting that after some study, she might be able to develop counter-measures for it. Jay obliged himself to satisfy P.I.X.A.L.'s request and approached one of the warriors he had rammed with his motorcycle, but Cole was quick to remind Jay not to touch the warriors, lest he be crystalized himself. As Jay hastily retreated, Cole tossed him his hammer, which Jay then used to break off a piece of a crystal spear. The fragment was collected by Kai and the ninja then retreated with their quarry.

A Lesson in Anger[]

On the retreat from the farmer's village, Cole stopped for a moment to provide aid to a pair of fleeing villagers. After knocking back the attacking squadron of Crystal Warriors with his cruiser's cannons, Cole let out a hearty laugh, mocking the warriors for their perceived invincibility. Unfortunately, Cole's boast proved to be premature, for the warriors soon rose again and counter-attacked with great ferocity. As the warriors now closed in on Cole, the earth ninja began to frantically jostle the controls of his cruiser, bemoaning the fact that his engine was now fried. Fortunately, aid would arrive just in time in the form of Jay and the Destiny's Bounty, buying enough time for Jay to safely tow Cole and his cruiser back to the Samurai X Cave.

After returning to the Samurai X Cave, Cole and the other ninja gathered around as Wu told them about his discovery of the Oni form and its potential ability to defeat the Crystal army. When Garmadon revealed his presence, Cole activated his earth punch in case Garmadon attempted to attack him or his friends. Luckily, there would be no need for hostilities, for Garmadon explained how he only intended to teach Lloyd to harness Oni form.

As Lloyd struggled to achieve Oni form, Cole and the others watched on with increasing discomfort as Garmadon began lambasting Lloyd for every perceived failure. After bracing several of Garmadon's insults, Cole and Jay finally intervened on Lloyd's behalf, with Cole pointing out in exasperation that Garmadon kept suggesting different techniques for Lloyd to follow as a means of achieving Oni form. Unfortunately, Garmadon ignored Cole's words and continued onwards with his brutal teaching style, further stoking the fires of tension between himself and the ninja. These tensions would finally come to a head when Garmadon blamed Wu's teachings for Lloyd's inability to achieve Oni form, greatly upsetting Cole who firmly stated that no one had a right to insult Master Wu. Even when Zane broke up the fight seconds later, Cole still refused to back away from his disdain for Garmadon and his teachings, stating that they needed to go out and confront the Crystal army head on rather than wasting anymore time on "nonsense."

Not long afterwards, P.I.X.A.L. revealed that she had made upgrades to the ninja's vehicles, thus enabling them to challenge the Crystal army head on. Amongst her instructions and warnings on the vehicular upgrades was for the ninja to be careful in utilizing their upgraded weapons systems so not to stress out their vehicles' engines. Cole however, brushed aside P.I.X.A.L.'s concerns, explaining that when it came down to risking burning out his cruiser's engine versus saving all of Ninjago City from the Overlord, he would always choose the former option as the more preferable one. And with that, Cole and the other three original ninja rushed to their vehicles and sped off towards Ninjago City.

Brave But Foolish[]

Arriving in the streets of Ninjago City, Cole eagerly activated his dragon cruiser's new upgrades in preparation for battle against the Crystal Warriors. After Kai's successful demonstration of the energy shielding's effectiveness against their foes, Cole joined in on the onslaught and helped to clear out a massive platoon of Crystal Warriors, shattering them instantly with his cruiser. Eventually, Cole's usage of his cruiser's shielding began overheating his engine and forced him to deactivate it while searching the city for more enemies alongside Kai.

As he drove alongside Kai, Cole saw in the corner of his eye that Kai's Golden Dragon Raider was suddenly rising into the air. After a quick, cursory glance to confirm this, Cole remarked that he was unaware that flight was part of Kai's raider's capabilities. This confused Kai who replied in panic that his vehicle was incapable of flight, causing Cole to take a longer look to realize that Kai was being lifted into the air by a Dragonide! In spite of Cole's shouts for Kai to blast off the creature, Kai's vehicle was incapable of firing behind it, and the Dragonide dropped Kai's raider atop of Cole's dragon cruiser. Surprised by the sudden collision, Cole lost control over his vehicle and crashed both his and Kai's vehicles not long after.

Safe Haven[]

Unconscious as a result of the crash, Cole was pulled from his damaged cruiser by Kai and briefly stirred, asking if they had won the battle. Unfortunately, Cole only remained semi-conscious and woozily gave away his and Kai's location when Pythor cheerily called out, "Come out wherever you are!" Fortunately, Skylor arrived just in time to back the two ninja up and copied Cole's powers of Earth alongside Kai's powers to erect a barrier separately them from Pythor and his Crystal Warriors.

As the trio began to leave the area, Cole fully woke up when Skylor revealed that their attack had failed and the Destiny's Bounty had crashed, snapping him back to reality as he listened in horror. Following Kai's lead, Cole and Skylor would make their way to Benny's Arcade, where they were startled by Jake. After receiving a transmission from Wu, containing a hint for survivors to seek out the Newspaper warehouse, Cole was overjoyed to hear his master's voice and commented briefly on his survival. He and the others would then make their way to the warehouse, with Kai leading the way. Upon arriving at the warehouse, Cole received a warm hug from Wu before running off to see what he could do to assist the Resistance.

Compatible[]

Cole and Nelson managed to successfully adjust the dispatch radio to the same frequency as the ninja's comms and celebrated their success. Cole then called Wu over to broadcast to their allies before taking over himself to excitedly let them know of their whereabouts. Before he could fully reveal their location, however, Wu cut him off to warn that their communications could be intercepted, leading for Cole to discreetly adjust himself by simply stating that they were located "Where the news never sleeps!"

Once the dispatch was completed, Wu asked Cole to reach out to Queen Vania to make good on her promise to back Cole up with the entire Army of Shintaro, though Cole noted they would need a much stronger signal in order to reach Shintaro. Although Vinny chimed in to offer the NGTV broadcast tower as a solution, Cole pointed out that it was on the other side of Ninjago City and they could not possibly make it there with the streets crawling with Crystal Warriors. The solution to this problem would soon reveal itself in the form of Racer Seven - who had since changed her name to the normal name of "Blazey H. Speed." Upon hearing Blazey's new name, Cole sarcastically muttered under his breath that her name was "really" normal before asking her what the "H" stood for.

Shortly thereafter, Cole, Vinny, and Blazey stepped out of the warehouse to Vinny's news van. Although Blazey eyed the vehicle with glittering eyes, Cole seemed more apprehensive and expressed concern about Blazey's ability to drive it, for it was nothing like the race car she drove in Prime Empire. Nonplussed, Blazey dismissed Cole's concerns and herded them all into the van before taking off at high speed.

Distress Calls[]

Alongside Vinny, Cole sat in the news van as Blazey drove them towards the NGTV News Center. During their travel, Cole and Vinny reacted to Blazey's reckless driving with horror, during which Cole sarcastically remarked that they must've broken a new land speed record. When the trio finally reached the top of the News Center, Cole began to broadcast his message to Vania, reminding her of the time she told him that if he ever needed help, she would bring the entire Army of Shintaro to his aid. Although Cole admitted she probably meant her words in a metaphorical sense, he stated he quite literally needed the entire Army of Shintaro in order to fight back against the Overlord and his Crystal Army. Unfortunately, Cole's broadcast would be cut short thanks to the arrival of several Dragonides, forcing him and his allies to retreat into the news center. When Cole asked Vinny if the latter thought the message was transmitted prior to the destruction of the transmission tower, he learned to his dismay that it most likely failed to transmit. Cole then reported his presumed failure to Wu and returned to the hideout with his allies.

An Issue of Trust[]

Arriving outside the Newspaper warehouse, Cole was reunited with his allies and watched as Kai shared a hug with P.I.X.A.L. Shortly thereafter, he and the others were ushered inside by Wu who spoke to them about his discovery of Dragon Form. Cole and the others then attempted to perform the art, but were unsuccessful. After many unsuccessful attempts, Cole admitted that Garmadon may have been right to suggest that Quanish was a fool, prompting Wu to angrily hurl the scroll to the ground in frustration and storm off. As it drifted to the ground, the sheet of paper gently landed beside Cole with one of its corners folding upon itself. Cole took note of this and the iconography present on the folded edge and picked up the scroll, gasping as he realized that the scroll was meant to be folded.

Wu then read aloud the transcription found on the folded scroll and questioned the meaning of its riddle, but time had run out; Cole's earlier eagerness to hear his allies' voices had bitten back, and the Crystal army was now rapidly approaching the warehouse after intercepting his transmission! When Kai emphasized that they had to move the civilians taking shelter in the warehouse to safety, Cole asked how they could possibly do that, for the streets were crawling with Crystal Warriors. Nevertheless, Cole expressed willingness to assist Lloyd and Garmadon in taking the fight directly to the Crystal King, but was shot down by Wu who stated that Cole and the other ninja were needed on the ground to draw attention away from Lloyd and his father.

In preparation for the final battle, Cole secured the alleyways surrounding the warehouse, barricading and sealing them off by raising walls of stone. Once this was completed, Cole took position in front of the warehouse with his allies and charged into battle against the Crystal army as the final battle begun.

Dragon Form[]

Cole swung his baseball bat to deflect the blasts from the Crystal Warriors. As he readied his Earth Punch, he realized that his powers were being suppressed due to the Crystal Warriors closing in on him. The Dragonides had successfully crystallized Ultra Violet, Killow, and Ronin, and the crystal army had cornered Cole and his allies in the warehouse. Suddenly, a roar echoed through the air, and Cole understood that Vania and the Shintarans had received his message. The Keepers, Benthomaar, Glutinous, the Maaray Guards, the Hypnobrai, the Red Visors, the Whack Rats, along with their friends and families, including Lou, arrived to support the Resistance. Recalling the strength of unity foretold in the Dragon Form scroll, Cole, Jay, Kai, and Zane unlocked their Dragon Forms. The ninja engaged in battle against the crystal army, with Cole facing off against Vangelis.

Vangelis chased Cole on his Dragonide, fueled by a fierce desire for revenge. Cole feigned ignorance, asking Vangelis to explain what he had supposedly done wrong. Vangelis accused Cole of usurping his throne and turning his own people, including Vania, against him. In a playful tone, Cole suggested that Vangelis was responsible for his own troubles. Vangelis, furious, dismissed Cole's claims, asserting that he had the Dragonide ready to capture him. He revealed that the Overlord wanted Cole alive, but with the Overlord absent, Vangelis intended to finish Cole off himself. Just as Vangelis prepared to strike with the Scythe of Destruction, Adam intervened, ensnaring Vangelis in webs. Cole thanked Vania and the Upply for their timely assistance. He managed to reclaim the scythe, but it began to corrupt him. Zane advised Cole to channel his elemental powers into the Scythe. Following this advice, Cole successfully transformed the scythe back into the Scythe of Quakes and used it to trap Vangelis in a sinkhole.

After the purification of all the Golden Weapons, the Crystal Warriors and the Dragonides started to lose their power. The Resistance took decisive action, eliminating all the stone creatures, effectively dismantling the crystal army. The ninja rejoiced in their victory, and Cole embraced Vania in a hug. However, Aspheera warned them that soon Cole and the others would fall under the Overlord's corruption, as their elemental powers would be seized. As the Crystal Island approached, Cole and the Resistance stood watch. Wu realized that the Overlord wanted to corrupt the Elements of Creation so he could destroy the Balance. However, the Overlord as moments away from winning.

Roots[]

Wu informed the ninja that in order to stop the Overlord from destroying the Balance, they needed to combine their Golden Weapons, which would cause their Elemental Powers to be expelled and would return to their original forms. Cole disagreed, arguing that without their powers and weapons, they would be defenseless. Wu countered by stating that they had already lost and their only hope was to prevent the Elements of Creation from falling into the hands of the Overlord. Zane agreed with Wu's plan. The ninja gathered on the rooftop of the newspaper warehouse and, with a final salute, united their Golden Weapons, resulting in the destruction and the release of their Elemental Powers. However, the Overlord managed to corrupt all of Ninjago, including Cole.

After Lloyd's victory over the Overlord, Cole noticed the Golden Ultra Dragon and asked the other ninja where it came from. As Lloyd approached, Cole saw Harumi and eyed her suspiciously. However, Lloyd assured them that Harumi was on their side. The group then approached the dragon, with Cole petting the Earth Dragon's head. As the dragon began to fade away, Cole remarked on its disappearance, and Wu explained that the Elemental Powers were returning to their origins. Cole asked Wu what their next move was, and Wu replied that they would rebuild as they always did. Cole then turned to speak with Misako.

A week passed, and Cole actively participated in the reconstruction of the Monastery of Spinjitzu. As he strolled through the ongoing work, he encountered the Upply and joined up with them. Plundar appeared behind Cole, and they warmly embraced each other.

Quest for the Lost Powers

Quest for the Lost Powers[]

Following the Ninja's victory during the Final prophecy of Quanish the Elder, Cole left the team in search of a new purpose. Specifically, he sought to do something that could better connect him with his former element, so he thought about trying his hand at farming, joining a farm owned by Sally-Bob. During his time there, Cole learned of the farmers' troubles with their greedy neighbor, Takanagi, who owned all of the surrounding land and had repeatedly tried to buy out the farmers. When those offers were refused, Takanagi resorted to harassment, aiming to drive them off their lands. Upon hearing this, Cole vowed to serve as the farm's protector for as long as he would be needed.

One day, Lou came to the farm to visit his son. At the time, Cole was trying to coax Henry, Sally-Bob's yak, into pulling a plow to till the fields and eventually managed to get it done just before his father greeted him. Surprised to see his father, Cole hugged him and explained his reasoning for picking up farming before introducing him to some of the other farmers. At nightfall, Cole and his father retreated to the barn to spend their night. However, they would be awoken by Henry, who was surprisingly imitating the sounds of a rooster. Although Lou, being a newcomer, was confused as to the significance of this call, Cole explained that Henry only made such noises under two circumstances: when it was nearly morning, or when they were under attack. And it was still several hours before daybreak, meaning only one thing.

After ordering his father to stay back, Cole stepped out of the barn and approached the large hill that separated Sally-Bob's property from Takanagi's. At the top of the hill stood a platoon of modified tractors driven by the latter's men; without a doubt, another raid was in store. Unfortunately, since Cole no longer possessed his elemental power of Earth, all he was able to do was to attack with bursts of Spinjitzu and hope for the best. Unfortunately, that proved to be insufficient at repelling the advancing forces, and Cole was quickly overwhelmed, unable to do anything except watch on sadly as the goons tore apart Sally-Bob's fields before retreating. When Lou checked in on his son, Cole downplayed his own injuries, explaining that he was more concerned about the security of the farm than himself.

As the hours ticked by, Cole admitted to his father that he sometimes felt powerless now that he no longer possessed his elemental powers, and wondered if his late mother had ever felt like this before. Lou affirmed this and relayed a story to his son dating back to when Cole was only a few years old. Following the story, Cole helped to train Sally-Bob and her farmers in the arts of self defense as they prepared for Takanagi's next attack. The next evening, Takanagi himself arrived to fully take the farm by force. Although the man boasted of great strength and power, his forces were quickly overwhelmed and routed by the farmers, thanks to Cole's training. Infuriated by this outcome, Takanagi mounted his modified harvester and spend on towards the farmers themselves. As Cole watched the farmers bravely stand their ground, refusing to budge an inch, Cole felt a familiar feeling of strength return to him. Commanding the earth itself, Cole raised up massive pillars of dirt and stone from beneath Takanagi, striking the businessman's harvester off the ground and hurling him beyond the horizon. The day had been saved.

Following this battle, Cole and his father spent some more time on the farm to help repair and restore the damages that had been inflicted upon it by Takanagi. The day eventually came however when both father and son departed the farm and went their separate ways. As he left, Cole promised Sally-Bob that he would return to help out during the harvest, and also encouraged her to call him and the other Ninja should they ever need help again. With a final goodbye to Henry, Cole and his father left Sally-Bob's farm behind, with Cole returning to the Monastery of Spinjitzu to rejoin his friends.

Dragons Rising, Season 1

Dragons Rising, Season 1[]

Cole was outside the Monastery with the rest of the ninja when the Merge began. To rescue as many citizens as possible, Cole and the others boarded the Destiny's Bounty and set off towards Ninjago City. Unfortunately, their proximity to the Merge caused Cole to become separated from the group once the Merge was completed.[13][14] He found himself stranded in the Land of Lost Things, a desolate valley within Imperium where forgotten items and people ended up. Cole was taken in by a group of runaways known as the Finders, who were in constant danger due to the presence of the Hoarder. In order to protect the Finders, who were unable to leave the valley due to being forgotten, Cole made the decision to remain in the Land of Lost Things. As time passed, Cole discovered a newfound ability to encase himself in stone, forming an Elemental Golem. However, he attributed this ability to a power-up granted by Geo, the Elemental Master of Fusion, rather than his own inherent capabilities.[15]

They Call It Doom[]

In his Elemental Golem form, Cole arrived to shield Fritz and Spitz from what he believed were potential threats - Nya, Sora, and Riyu. In his misguided attempt to safeguard the children, Cole engaged in a battle with the trio. However, as Nya used Spinjitzu, Cole recognized Nya, realizing his error in perceiving her as an adversary.

Land of Lost Things[]

Sora's mention of the Kingdom of Shintaro caught Cole off guard, causing his Elemental Golem to break apart. Surprised, Cole commented on how someone must have done their research on him. Sora revealed that her best friend, Arin, was a fan of the ninja and even styled his hair like Zane's. Cole hoped that Sora was joking, but she confirmed that it was true but added that Arin never mentioned Cole encasing himself in an Elemental Golem. Admitting that it was a new development, Cole turned to Nya and asked if she has found anyone else. Nya revealed that they haven't located Jay, Master Wu, and P.I.X.A.L. yet. As he was introduced to Sora and Riyu, Cole acknowledged that he has missed a lot and explained that news was scarce in the Land of Lost Things. Curious, Nya asks if the valley was where Cole woke up after the Merge, and Cole confirmed, mentioning that he had no idea where he was until the Finders took him in. Cole further confirmed that the Land of Lost Things was indeed real and that lost things can come from any realm other than Imperium. Intrigued by the yellow Dragon Core, Cole learned that it was an artifact that could save the Merged Realms. Reflecting on the mission of saving the world, Cole remarked that it was comforting to know that some things never changed. However, their conversation was abruptly interrupted by the sudden attack of the Hoarder, who threw a car at them. The Hoarder chased Cole, the ninja, and the Finders, but Cole tried to divert its attention by throwing a container at it. Unfortunately, it didn't work. Nya asked Cole where the Hoarder came from, but he didn't know either. He explained that the Hoarder had been around for as long as he could remember. To escape from the Hoarder, Cole suggested that they go inside the giant noodle cup, where they reunited with Geo.

Concerned, Geo asked Cole if he was alright, to which Cole reassured him that he was fine. Nya questioned the need for hiding, stating that they should have no trouble dealing with the Hoarder. Cole explained that every time they've confronted it directly, it only grows stronger and more dangerous. Geo decided to create a diversion to buy them some time, urging Cole to go. Cole activated his powers, preparing to dig a tunnel. However, he heard screaming that he attributed to the earth itself. Despite this, Cole insisted that they must press on and lead the way into the tunnel. Emerging from the tunnel at a safe distance, they observe the Hoarder attacking a noodle cup. Nya was concerned for Geo's safety, but Cole informed her just to wait for what happens next. Geo, utilizing his Elemental Powers, fused the noodle cup with the Hoarder's hand. Cole and the rest of the group ride Jiro and Zanth to the Rookery, marveling at the sculptures Geo made along the way. Cole then explained Geo was the Elemental Master of Fusion, allowing him to forge unbreakable bonds between objects. Sora related to the concept of making art, sharing her own experience of repurposing old items to create new technology. Cole asked about Sora's specific Elemental Power, to which she hesitantly responded that it was Technology, but mentioned her belief that it came from Riyu. Cole added that the origin of one's power may not be as important as how it was used for the greater good. Nya then mentioned the Merge, which had brought about new Elemental Powers like Technology and Fusion. Cole pondered the fact of the creation of new Elemental Powers due to the realms being united. Cole was asked about the trigger for his Elemental Golem. Before he can respond, their conversation was interrupted by the roar of the Hoarder.

Upon entering inside the Rookery, Cole instructed Fritz, Spitz, and Bonzle to prepare a meal for Nya and Sora. Nya asked Cole about the Finders and their connection to the Land of Lost Things. Cole confirmed Nya's suspicions and proceeded to explain that the Finders were indeed denizens who became lost and forgotten, eventually ending up in the Land of Lost Things after running away from their homes. As they engaged in conversation, their attention was suddenly drawn to what was keeping the Hoarder away. Cole revealed that it was a noise-making machine, which had been created long before he and the Finders stumbled upon it. Cole admitted that it was the most advanced machine he had ever encountered, but playfully added that Zane should be kept in the dark about his opinion. Intrigued by its power source, Nya's curiosity led Cole to open the door to the machine, revealing the yellow Dragon Core. Nya's attempt to take the Yellow Dragon Core was met with resistance from Cole, who questioned her actions. However, Nya reminded Cole of their mission to save the world and emphasized the importance of the Core in achieving that goal. Cole explained that the machine was necessary to keep the Hoarder at bay and without it would put them in danger. Nya suggested taking Cole and the Finders with them, as all three Dragon Cores are needed to prevent the world from destruction. However, Geo informed them that those who were forgotten couldn't leave the Land of Lost Things due to a mysterious fog. Sora proposed a different approach, suggesting that they find a new power source to operate the machine instead of directly confronting the Hoarder. With her knowledge of Imperium tech and Riyu's dragon power, she believed she can reconfigure the machine to work with a different power source. She handed Nya and Cole a list of required parts to proceed with her plan.

While Cole and Nya were looking for parts, Nya noticed the remains of a portal gate. Curious, she asked Cole where he had found it. Cole replied that Geo had discovered it and asked what a portal gate was. Nya was surprised by Cole's lack of knowledge and realized that they had a lot to catch up on with each other. Soon, they were searching for an influx stabilizer that Sora urgently needs. Cole admitted his lack of understanding about the device, feeling out of his depth. As they continue their search, they are abruptly interrupted by the alarming sight of Imperium Drones attacking Jiro. Nya was concerned about how Beatrix could have known of their presence. Cole asks about Beatrix, but Nya insists that there was no time for explanations. Their attention was diverted when they noticed the Hoarder's arrival, with Cole noticing its newly rebuilt hand. Cole decided to take on the Hoarder, while Nya focused on fighting the drones. As the battle went on, Nya suggested that Cole should utilize his Elemental Golem. However, Cole revealed that he can only access this power when Geo boosts him with with Fusion. Nya was surprised at the revelation, questioning why Cole hadn't mentioned it earlier. Cole explains that they have a lot to catch up on, and Nya said that it was unusual for people to share Elemental Powers in such a way. Cole brought up Sora and Riyu as examples. However, Nya mentioned that fact that they're simply just Sora's powers. Before they can delve further into the discussion, Jiro intervened, grabbing Cole and Nya and carrying them away to safety.

Cole managed to catch Geo just as he was about to fall. Cole greeted Geo with a playful remark, being surprise at their unexpected encounter. Nya quickly informed them of the urgent task at hand, emphasizing the need to retrieve the Dragon Core from LaRow. However, the Hoarder returned, as the Rookery no longer had the core. Cole reassured Geo that they were not defenseless, reminding him of the ninja's skills. He instructed Nya to pursue LaRow while focused on evacuating the other Finders from the Rookery to safety. Cole then turned to Geo, urging him to empower him. However, Geo hesitated, causing Cole to become impatient. Despite the setback, Geo seemingly transfer his powers to Cole, and Cole used his Elemental Golem form and charged towards the Hoarder. Zanth managed to tear off a piece of the Hoarder, earning praise from Cole for her bravery. Unfortunately, the Hoarder retaliated by seizing Zanth and forcefully slamming her onto Cole, causing his Elemental Golem form to be break apart. Sora used her Elemental Powers to dismantle the Hoarder, revealing that the Hoarder was just a magnetic organism named Sweeper. Geo commended Sora for saving them all, to which Sora acknowledged that she couldn't have accomplished it without receiving a power boost from Riyu. Cole added that he also couldn't have held off Sweeper without Geo's Elemental Powers. However, Geo revealed that he doesn't actually possess enhance Cole's powers. Confused, Cole mentioned his reliance on Geo's assistance, but Geo explained that his powers don't affect living beings. Cole realized that it had been his own abilities all along and acknowledged that he needed Geo to help him realize his true potential in his Elemental Golem.

Absolute Power[]

Cole, Nya, and Sora discussed their plans on how to enter Imperium, which would be hard because of the energy barrier. Sora contemplated the idea of building armor for Jiro, which would enhance his natural energy and enable him to break through the energy barrier. Riyu provides Sora with a power boost, and she combines various parts using her elemental powers. After completing the armor, Sora attaches it to Jiro, while Cole observes that Jiro liked it. As the ninja prepared to leave, Cole told Nya how he had previously mentioned hearing the ground screaming, informing that the previous night he heard a voice calling out to him from the edge of the valley. Nya immediately recognized it as Wu's voice, as she had once followed it in the Cloud Kingdom, leading her to Kai and ultimately saving Lloyd and the others. Cole revealed that Master Wu was calling him to follow. Nya encouraged him to go, emphasizing that if he heard Master Wu's voice, he should always follow. Cole expressed his gratitude and determination, stating that his journey would now take him elsewhere. As Nya and Sora departed on their dragons, the golden sphere appeared behind Cole, calling his name. Intrigued, Cole chased after it.

Prior to The Elemental Mechs

Prior to The Elemental Mechs[]

At some point, Cole took a break from his pursuit of the golden sphere and returned to the monastery and reunited with the other ninja, eventually learning that many dangerous artifacts, including Chronosteel, were being smuggled somewhere and immediately went to warn them.

The Elemental Mechs

The Elemental Mechs[]

What the Mech?[]

Cole arrives, having ridden an Earth Dragon, only to crash into Kai, Sora, and Lloyd's other student Arin, who were on Kai's Super Awesome Slide Course while Lloyd was away before telling him the reason for his return. Arin instantly knew where the Chronosteel would be in Kreel's Junkyard, who boasted about it through advertisements.

Cole, Kai, Sora, and Arin then went to Kreel's Junkyard just in time to witness Lobbo absorb a surge of energy from one of the items and transform into a larger, monstrous form. Cole commanded the others to attack but they were all soon overpowered. After being knocked away a second time, Cole wearily glanced over his shoulder to see Sora inspecting a piece of Chronosteel. Although he tried to warn her about the material and its abilities to contain elemental power, Sora used it to construct three mechs, one of which she gave to Cole. Using his new mech, Cole helped Kai subdue Lobbo long enough for Sora to reverse his transformation. The ninja then spotted Kreel attempting to transport the hazardous materials out of her junkyard, prompting Cole to confiscate the items Kreel was intending to transport. Kai then proposed an idea to use these items to enhance his slide course, earning him an immediate glare from Cole and disapproving looks from Sora and Arin.

The Mech Master[]

Cole walked with Kai, Sora, Arin, Riyu, and Nya towards the Mech-Master 5000's stands, telling Arin about Chef Grab-Barg's Creme de Imperium pies.

Cole and the other ninja were at the stands watching the Mech-Master Race 5000 begin when the Mechanic attacked and took over the mechs of the racers. Cole, Sora, and Kai then showed up in their mechs, blocking the Mechanic's path. The Mechanic then sent one of the mechs to crash into the three mechs, breaking all three and shattering the barrier. As the Mechanic raced away, Cole told Sora to chase the Mechanic while he and Kai took on the other mechs.

As Sora put her mech back together with mismatched limbs from the other mechs and chased the Mechanic, Cole and Kai put their own mechs back together, also with mismatched limbs.

When one of the Mechanic's mechs moved towards his mech, Cole used an arm that was originally from Kai's mech to shoot fire, knocking it down. Kai then used an arm originally from Cole's mech to use the element of Earth to knock the other mech down. When both mechs charged at them again, Cole and Kai used each other's powers to knock them down, with both ninja remarking the same thing at the same time afterwards.

After Sora defeated the Mechanic, Cole and the other ninja caught up to her in their mechs.

Later, Cole and the other ninja walked down the racetrack.

A Pain in the Mech![]

Kai, Cole, Arin, Sora, and Riyu gathered at the Crossroads to witness the noodle cook-off. As they arrived, Cole cheekily expressed his belief that no noodles could beat those from Chen's Noodle House and showed off the bowl he had brought from the establishment, much to Sora's dismay. When she asked why he brought outside noodles, Cole replied it was a precaution in case he didn't like the ones at the cook-off. Sora then offered him some of her noodles, though Cole rejected them for having too many conflicting flavors. Seconds later, a pair of Ice Dragons launched an attack much to the horror of the nearby Lava-Tide chef.

Gearing into action, Cole activated his elemental mech alongside Sora and Kai but briefly expressed incredulity to Arin's request for the ninja not to hurt the Ice Dragons. As the ninja began to combat the Ice Dragons, Cole also attacked the Lava-Tides who were creating just as much destruction in the Crossroads. This angered them into branding the ninja as enemies as well, forcing the ninja to swap parts from each others mechs to qwell the threat.

Following the exposure of the Lava-Tide chef's theft of the Ice Dragons' eggs, Riyu pushed him against his oven, causing his noodles to scatter in all directions. Cole and the others then promptly returned the eggs to the Ice Dragons and made their way back to the Monastery of Spinjitzu where he discovered that the noodles from Chen's mixed in with the Crossroads noodles had created the perfect blend of noodles!

Prior to Dragons Rising, Season 2

Prior to Dragons Rising, Season 2[]

Following the noodle cook-off, Cole left Ninjago to continue his mission. Once he successfully accomplished his task, Cole journeyed towards the Land of Lost Things to reunite with the Finders.[16]

Dragons Rising, Season 2

Dragons Rising, Season 2[]

Force From the East[]

Cole learned that the Wolf Mask Warriors were after Bonzle for unknown reasons. Cole swiftly launched an attack to assist the Finders in rescuing Bonzle from the clutches of the Wolf Mask Warriors, successfully defeating them and securing Bonzle's safety. Despite his victory, Cole warned the Finders to take cover, anticipating the arrival of more Wolf Mask Warriors seeking to capture Bonzle. Using his Earth powers, Cole created a shelter to shield the Finders from any further attempts by the Wolf Mask Warriors to capture Bonzle. Following the creation of the shelter, Cole conversed with the Finders, who were relieved at his return and shared that they had missed him. Cole, pleased to have arrived in time to help, inquired about the situation in the Cloud Kingdom. Despite Cole's efforts in creating a shelter, the Wolf Mask Warriors began to breach it, prompting Geo to use his powers to reinforce the barrier and prevent them from reaching Bonzle. Unfortunately Geo's efforts were in a vain, as Ras in the Cloud Kingdom commanded two of Writers of Destiny to use the Mallet of Shattering on the Gong of Shattering the transforming Wolf Mask Warriors at the Land of Lost Things into Wolf Mask Claw Warriors and being able to continue breach through the shelter. Cole stumbled upon a portal gate nearby and decided to reconstruct it in order to escape the Wolf Mask Claw Warriors with the help of the Finders. Once the gate was successfully rebuilt, Cole and the Finders ventured through it and found themselves back in Ninjago, astonished by the turn of events. Upon encountering Zane and Alfonzo Frohicky, Cole was puzzled by Zane's frog man doll. Subsequently, Cole sought Zane's assistance in defeating the Wolf Mask Claw Warriors.

The Spell at the Waterfall[]

Arriving in the Monastery of Spinjitzu and reuniting with Zane and Mr. Frohicky, Cole and the Ninja of Ice quickly turned the tide and repelled the two Wolf Mask Claw Warriors, sending them both back through the portal. Everyone then relocated to the relaxation room, where Bonzle presented a shadow puppet play about her origins to Cole, Geo, and Zane. Cole sat next to Geo as he listened to Bonzle's story. Afterwards, he inquired as to why Bonzle had never told any of them about her past before and she quietly admitted that she had been afraid if they knew about her origins, they wouldn't want her to be part of their family anymore. Cole was quick to dismiss such thoughts and promised Bonzle that he did not care about her origins and that she would always be part of their family. Zane interrupted the tender moment to point out that Ras was likely seeking Bonzle because she could release the Forbidden Five from the Nether-Space. Cole then proposed searching for Bonzle's creator in order to keep her safe and began to prepare for a journey to Mysterium.

To Mysterium[]

With the decision made to search Mysterium for Bonzle's creator, Cole and the others were briefly sidetracked by the sudden disappearance of Fritz and Spitz. Following the children into the hangar bay, they discovered that the kids had commandeered Sora's SA Mark 01 and almost immediately lost control. Cole retrieved his Elemental Earth Mech in response and used it to stop the out of control racer mech before continuing with Zane and Bonzle to ask Jiro to aid them in searching for Mysterium.

Since Bonzle had not been to Mysterium in millennia, and the ninja lacked accurate maps of the Merged lands, the three decided to go to the Crossroads in search of one. Bonzle and Cole quickly decided to check out the All-Realm Antiques Emporium, which was owned by Fedulian, though Zane advised not to go in because of Fedulian's record of being untrustworthy and due to seeing Zane before. Fedulian then offered the three a variety of items, including a Party toaster, before Cole flat out asked for a trustworthy map of the Merged Lands. To their surprise, Fedulian produced one and gave it to them for free, stating that he had a drawer full of them.

As they fly to Mysterium, they discover the map is not accurate as they're coming across a poisonous cloud, which forces them to land with Jiro injured from the poison. As they land the three discovered the markings on the map had disappeared - Fedulian had given them a fake map! Nevertheless, they were still stranded in the desert and with Jiro too injured to fly, they had no choice but to start walking on foot, eventually encountering Dorama's puppet which defeated and brought them to Dorama's Academy for Acting.

Cole later woke up, discovering to his relief for starters that they were all still alive! Though now they were imprisoned behind what appeared to be a stage surrounded by an electric grid alongside many other citizens. They were then greeted by their captor, Dorama, whom neither Cole nor Zane recognized. Cole quickly grew tired of Dorama's pompous behavior however and huddled with his allies to discuss a plan of escape. Due to Bonzle's magical nature, she was able to pass through the grid without trouble and shut it down from the outside. Cole then summoned his Elemental Mech to combat Dorama's Puppet, ultimately defeating it after luring it to the stage which Cole then damaged to bring down its ceiling supports to crush the puppet with. Dorama was soon dispatched and handed over to the other prisoners to be taken to the Crossroads. With Jiro now finally recovered, Cole and his allies made their way finally to Mysterium where they were surprisingly greeted by another monastery.

Fugitives From Madness[]

As Cole and the others stepped into the monastery, they quickly realized that this place was not the Monastery of Spinjitzu. Cole noticed that the interior was quite different compared to the Monastery of Spinjitzu. He began to wonder if the Monastery of Mysterium was merely an illusion, but Zane assured him that it was indeed real. While exploring, Cole noticed a crack in the wall shaped like a noodle bowl, which reminded him of the one he and Jay had accidentally created during an argument over a video game controller. He felt a pang of nostalgia and missed Jay, pondering where he might be after the Merge. Just then, the yellow orb appeared and floated into the monastery, capturing Cole's attention. He turned to Zane for answers, but Zane could only share that they had encountered the orb before without much detail. Moments later, the Sorceress revealed herself as Gandalaria, explaining that the yellow orb was named Spirte. Gandalaria claimed that the arrival of Cole and his friends would bring significant changes, and she began asking for slugs. This left Cole puzzled until he realized she was actually waiting for the Slug Merchants, not the ninja. Gandalaria then spotted Bonzle and was taken aback, recognizing her from a spell she had cast long ago.

Cole concentrated on their current mission and addressed Gandalaria as Sorceress. However, Gandalaria preferred to be called by her true name. Despite her request, Cole continued to use the title Sorceress, finding it difficult to pronounce Gandalaria. He warned her about the urgent need to protect Bonzle from Ras and the Wolf Clan, explaining that Ras aimed to release the Forbidden Five. Cole and Zane shared their concerns, revealing that Ras had discovered how to conduct the Ritual of the Blood Moon, which was approaching quickly. Cole emphasized the danger, stating that if the Forbidden Five were freed, they could dominate all the Merged Realms. Gandalaria countered this idea, asserting that the Forbidden Five would not conquer but rather destroy the Merged Realms. She suggested they venture into the Wyldness to find an item that could protect Bonzle, and Cole proposed they travel there on Jiro. Their discussion was abruptly interrupted by a knock at the door. Initially, Cole feared it was the Wolf Clan, but they soon realized it was the Administration Agents, who were demanding Zane's return. Cole was shocked to learn that Zane had previously been kidnapped by the Administration Agents and had been rescued by Lloyd and Arin.

The Blood Moon had just risen when Zane an offer to surrender himself. Roderick, however, pointed out that Zane, as a Nindroid, was viewed as mere machinery and not a true living being. If Zane chose to give himself up, would be taken to the Department of Demolitions, which Cole quickly noted would effectively mean Zane's death. Roderick dismissed Cole's concerns, arguing that Zane's demise was insignificant compared to that of a human. He also warned that anyone who helped Zane would face severe consequences, including termination by the Administration Agents, putting Cole and the others at risk. Annoyed, Cole urged his friends to escape on Jiro, but the Administration Agents had already captured Jiro. Cole demanded Jiro's release, but Roderick merely suggested they could discuss it while heading to the incinerator. As the Administration Agents prepared to invade the Monastery of Mysterium, Zane cleverly stalled them by claiming they needed to complete paperwork, which initially confused Cole. While the agents were distracted with the forms, Zane attempted to take the blame for their predicament, but Cole insisted they were all in this together. Meanwhile, Gandalaria sent Bonzle to hide in the passages, guided by Sprite, while she, Cole, and Zane prepared to confront the Administration Agents, using Gandalaria's crystal ball for support. Cole initially thought Gandalaria's crystal ball would be unexciting until she clarified that it was not an ordinary one. Just then, the Administration Agents broke through the walls, prompting Cole to summon his Elemental Earth Mech to battle them alongside the Master Mechs.

Secrets of the Wyldness[]

The battle outside the Monastery of Mysterium continued to rage on. With his earth mech, Cole made short work of the opposing Administration Agents, shouting at them to "File this permit in triplicate," in reference to his punches, earning an unimpressed look from Zane. Taking note of his friend's expression, Cole defended his joke by saying this was the only time it would make sense. The three Master Mechs then lined-up to face Cole who defiantly took a stance and dared them to attack; Cole's smugness was almost immediately rewarded with an attack by two of the Master Mechs. Nevertheless, with Cole being a seasoned warrior, he made short work of the attacking agents and laughed that the battle was almost too easy to the point it seemed unfair for the opposition. Yet again, Cole's remarks would instantly backfire on him when the Master Mechs released their corresponding Dragon Mechs, doubling the number of mechanized targets for the ninja. In spite of these reinforcements, the ninja and Gandalaria were able to defeat the Administration Agents after rebooting Zane so that he could deactivate the Administration mechs. The group then retreated atop of Jiro and made their way to the Wyldness.

Soon after arriving above the Forest of Spirits, the ninja caught sight of the Cloud Kingdom and ordered Jiro to stay low to evade the eyes of the Wolf Clan. The group then decided to continue on foot until they reached the Magical storagehouse. Cole at first was perplexed by the size of the building, remarking that while it was cute, he doubted it could even fit a single person inside. Gandalaria scoffed at Cole's worries and simply replied that he didn't understand magic. When the group finally entered, Cole marveled in speechless awe at the significantly larger interior of the storage house, admitting that maybe he did misunderstand magic. Cole then assisted Gandalaria in removing the Protective container from one of the shelves but accidentally knocked down and shattered a vase in the process. Cole then reassured Bonzle that she would only have to hide inside the container up until the passing of the Blood Moon and watched in awe as Gandalaria began the spell of sealing. Unfortunately, Jordana intervened and seized control over the protective container, entrapping the ninja and sorceress inside an electro barrier. After Cole failed to escape with Spinjitzu, Jordana revealed herself though Cole flat out stated he did not recognize her nor have any idea of what she meant by seeking revenge on the ninja. When she left, Cole repeated to his entrapped allies their need to escape and to save Bonzle, striking at the shield again with Spinjitzu but to no avail.

The Forest of Spirits[]

Zane interaced with electro-wall generator and shut down the shield. Now released, Cole quickly rushed to the doors only to discover they had been magically sealed. Shouting that they had to save Bonzle, Cole attempted to break down the doors with his earth punch, but to no avail. Taking note of his friend's heightened emotional state, Zane acknowledged it but urged for Cole to remain calm. Gandalaria then perked up and stated that the storagehouse had other passageways, leading the way as the two ninja followed her.

After several fruitless attempts, Gandalaria began rummaging through the many potion vials, carelessly tossing them over her shoulder where Zane and Cole stood. Among the ones they were hit by included antigravity, anti-antigravity, and a slime that stuck to Cole's mouth and required Zane's assistance in removing. When the slime was removed, Cole realized to his horror that his voice had transferred over to the slime. This was resolved when Zane reattached and removed the slime from Cole's mouth a second time. Another potion that began to alter Zane's size randomly and uncontrollably; and yet another one turned Cole temporarily into a dog. After Gandalaria accidentally dropped the bottle containing an "instant opener" spell, Cole realized that Zane's size-shifting was the solution they needed. Scooping up his buddy when he was in his tiny form, Cole brought Zane's to the keyhole to unlock it from within. Zane did so and the three ran out of the storagehouse.

As they traversed the forest, the group encountered the portion of Cloud Kingdom controlled by the Wolf Clan. Cole believed that Bonzle was being held there and began ascending the Kingdom's anchor alongside Zane with Spinjitzu.

Rising Ninja[]

Arriving at Cloud Kingdom, Cole reiterated the need to find Bonzle; instead, all they found were the Writers of Destiny who were chained to their easels. Cole asked them about Bonzle's whereabouts, but the Writers confirmed that they had not seen her and that Ras had set their island to crash. Cole immediately assisted in snapping apart the Writers' chains and pulled out his Earth Mech in an effort to stop the island from crashing.

Arriving in the island's engine room, Cole attempted to straighten out the main rotor with his mech with little success. To make matters worse, Cole's strength succeeded in accidentally snapping the rotor in two and his mech was not tall enough to serve as a temporarily replacement. When Zane offhandedly wished there were a way to increase the size of Cole's mech, Cole came to a realization and ran off to find Gandalaria. The sorceress then used her size-altering potion on Zane so that he could serve as a temporary rotor, straightening out the island with unknown help from Euphrasia.

Later, when the ninja all regrouped at Cloud Kingdom, Cole greeted Lloyd with a warm hug before speaking with Zane and Gandalaria about Bonzle's sacrifice in which Cole briefly corrected the sorceress' words and emphasized that she was a selfless person, not a spell.

Magic Mayhem![]

Before the ninja could leave Cloud Kingdom, Gandalaria discovered an abandoned spell attached to a piece of rubble. Cole noted the spell's appearance closely resembled the dragon cores and warned it could be dangerous in the wrong hands. Although the ninja had many other matters to investigate, they agreed that the spell had to be examined more carefully. Since Cole and Zane had previously been to Gandalaria's storagehouse, the two were asked to stay with her to analyze the spell, much to Cole's dismay.

Cole's concerns would prove well founded, for mayhem began almost the moment the three walked through the storagehouse. Zane had prepared his ice powers to contain the spell should it prove dangerous, but in doing so, he failed to take into account several nearby potion vials which froze and burst from their containers. The three were affected by a shrinking potion, and unlike the size-altering potion, this one's effects were permanent unless the antidote was administered. To Cole's frustration, Gandalaria kept the antidote stored at the very top of the same shelf...the one that was now the size of a multi-story skyscraper in comparison to the three of them. Without a choice, Cole began to use Spinjitzu to propel himself up the shelves, only pausing in fright when he encountered a spider which was determined to make Cole its next meal.

Cole knocked the spider away with Spinjitzu and crashed into several other vials, including the antidote, knocking them to the ground and restoring himself, Zane, and Gandalaria to their normal sizes. The spider then accidentally tipped over a revitalizing elixir which spilled over various pieces of furniture and brought them to life. Gandalaria gave Cole and Zane special stickers and tasked them to slap them onto the runaway furniture, explaining that the paste would make them motionless again. Cole tackled an upholstered chair but knocked it back with a little too much force. In doing so, he accidentally tipped over another container and spilled a liquid over his head as Cole groaned that things were not going to go well as the liquid transformed his head into that of a llama's! Finally losing his patience, Cole shouted to Gandalaria that he had enough of the magical mayhem. Gandalaria reversed the effects applied to Cole's head, albeit requiring two tries to do so, and the ninja could finally get back to analyzing the abandoned spell.

To Cole's delight, the spell turned out to be one for cooking and it materialized a wondrous feast, one he found to be quite delicious!

Zane's PIXAL Project[]

Cole met with Kreel and Lobbo at the monastery, with the latter two informing him that Zane had gone crazy over a robot Kreel had made and that the robot was now rampaging across their junkyard. Taking the two to his Dragon Cruiser, Cole drove them back to the junkyard while explaining Zane's affections for P.I.X.A.L. and how her continued disappearance had been affecting him as of late.

After arriving in the junkyard, Cole spoke some sense back into Zane and helped him accept that the robot was not P.I.X.A.L., nor could it ever be her. After reassuring him that one day they would be reunited, Cole allowed Kreel and Lobbo to destroy the robot and comforted Zane.

Prior to Enter the City of Temples[]

After the Ritual of the Blood Moon, Cole accompanied Geo and the remaining Finders back to the Land of Lost Things, and stayed with them until he returned to the monastery by himself. Coincidentally shortly before Geo had received his invitation to the Tournament of the Sources.[17]

Enter the City of Temples[]

Cole participated in Lloyd's "stew-jitsu" training and later traveled with the other ninja to the Dragon Stone Shrine where they would enter the City of Temples. Like the others, Cole was confused about how they were to activate the city's elevator due to not possessing invitations to the tournament. When Bleckt introduced himself and explained that there was a simple solution to the ninja's problem, Cole expressed relief, admitting that he was afraid they would have to jump through some hoops to gain admittance. Cole's hopes were dashed, however, when Bleckt stated the solution was for the ninja to get lost.

With no other options, the ninja began to climb their way up to the city, with Cole riding atop of Zanth alongside Zane. The ninja were soon intercepted by the city's Security Bots, forcing them to defend themselves. Cole back-flipped and kicked one in midair before using his control over earth to pull out portions of the cliff face to strike down two robots with. All the ninja then followed Jiro's plan and leapt off the dragons, using their Dragon Hooks to scale up the rest of the way while the dragons kept the robots busy. As they climbed, Cole briefly commented on Wyldfyre's fear of heights, expressing disbelief that she had such a fear when she consistently rode atop of dragons with no issue. After reaching the City of Temples, Sora realized that Arin was not with them and asked if anyone had seen him. Cole answered in reply that he saw Arin hitching a ride on top of one of the Security Bots and that Riyu had gone after him too.

They Gather for the Feast[]

Cole and the other ninja soon caught up with Arin and Riyu before embarking on a tour with Bleckt and Roby. After reuniting with Arin, he introduced the ninja to his best friend before the merge, Frak, whom Cole recalled had taught Arin how to bake pies. Cole complimented Frak's pie recipes, remarking that while he was normally a lover of cake, the pies Arin made were some of the best he's ever had. These comments stunned Frak with happiness until he had to run off for training with his master. The ninja then began their tour proper, during which Cole gazed around the sights of the city with a relaxed look.

Later that evening, the ninja entered the Temple of Tournaments for the pre-game banquet. Cole marveled in awe at the wide variety of delicious foods and rushed on ahead to enjoy himself, later regrouping with the others to listen to Roby's speech and bore witness to Zeatrix's angry ranting. When the banquet finished, the ninja went their assigned quarters where Cole began setting up a photo of himself and the Finders. The other ninja discussed potential suspects behind the murders of the Arc Dragons, and Cole supported Arin's suggestion that Ras was behind it, pointing out that the tiger man conducted the Ritual of the Blood Moon a few months back to bring back the Forbidden Five. Cole wondered if Ras' failure to release all the Five forced him to kill the dragons and take their crowns as a backup plan for the tournament.

As the ninja slept, an Attacker bot discreetly entered their quarters and attempted to kill Lloyd with a Gilba Thorn. Their struggle woke the other ninja, including Cole, who then fought back against the bot and pursued it outside of their quarters and into the city. At one point, Cole and Zane attempted to attack the bot with Spinjitzu but were thrown off course when the bot deployed a smoke bomb. Both would later regroup with Lloyd in the city after he dispatched the bot and everyone was awoken by the commotion.

Inside the Maze[]

Cole was exploring the City of Temples when he ran into Geo, who had received his invitation after Cole had left. They ventured together and discovered a Titan Mech, likely belonging to a past Elemental Master of Earth—Cole wondered if it might have been his mother's.

Cole was in the Temple City quarters when Lloyd told everyone it was time to go to the game plaza. However since Roby refused to tell who everyone is competing against until the event itself annoyed the Ninja. Cole met with the ninja as they agreed to only use Rising Dragon to counter Shatterspin. After Zane lost to Zur, Cole was surprise to see Nya's opponent was Jay. His surprise deepened as he saw his old friend on Ras’ team, treating Nya as if she were a stranger. Cole couldn’t believe it, insisting that Jay would never forget Nya or any of them. He even tried to convince himself that Ras had somehow created a fake Jay with a loser wearing a Jay wig, but Lloyd reminded him that none of them knew what had happened to Jay after his disappearance in the Merge. Cole nervously watched as Jay attacked Nya and even used a Wolf Mask to shatter his goodness. Although Nya won, Cole and the others realized Jay had been lost to evil. When Nya tried to comfort him, Jay expressed nothing but hatred for Nya, leaving Cole and the others shaken by the deep change in their friend.

United We Fall[]

After Nya’s match with Jay, Cole and the others (minus Wyldfyre) headed to the Wolf Clan quarters, determined to confront them and demand Jay's return. Standing firmly by Nya's side, Cole helped her confront Ras, demanding that he undo whatever he had done to Jay. But Ras coldly informed them that Jay was already gone—he had sent him away for his failure. When Nya wanted to go after Jay and save him, Cole reminded her that Ras was playing them: the only reason he sent Jay off was so he could get rid of the ninja should they go after him. Nya countered that they will go after him because Jay needed them; not only had Jay lost his memories, but he also used the Gong of Shattering and they would need to help Jay heal his inner goodness. But Lloyd and Zane backed Cole up and told her that the Tournament of Sources is a threat to the Merged Lands and if it is destroyed then Jay will never be saved.

Truth and Lies[]

Cole charged ahead in the Combo Vehicle, weaving through the track with relentless focus. As the four ninjas raced through the tunnel, they were suddenly confronted by a massive cave-in, blocking their path with no escape. Without missing a beat, Sora sprang into action, merging all four vehicles into one unstoppable machine. The newly combined vehicle plowed through the rubble effortlessly, clearing the path. With a burst of acceleration, they passed the Pace Dragon, surging ahead and crossing the finish line in first place. Roby’s voice echoed over the loudspeaker, announcing that the ninjas had secured their spot in the Tournament of the Sources.

Later, Cole watched as Euphrasia and Zeatrix clashed fiercely on floating platforms. Then, during the match between Nokt and Tox, Cole rushed to help when Nokt severely injured Tox, assisting her onto a stretcher.

When Roby called Cole and Frak as the next competitors, Cole was caught off guard to see Arin standing next to Frak, looking out of place. Facing off against Frak, Cole couldn't help but be perplexed by Frak's overenthusiastic fanboy attitude. As the two climbed the obstacle, Cole realized it seemed to be designed for Frak’s abilities, not his own. Frak rang the bell first, forcing Cole to surrender his Earth power to him. After the match, Cole confided in Lloyd, noting how the competition felt rigged against them. Lloyd agreed, his eyes narrowing suspiciously at Roby and Bleckt.

During Nya’s match with Nokt, Cole tried to calm Wyldfyre, but her defiant response—saying her anger helped her stay focused—only frustrated him more. As Nya battled Nokt, Cole kept a watchful eye on Wyldfyre, making sure she didn’t lose control of her emotions. Later Cole and the other Ninja watched Sora and Cinder's fight.

Later at night, Cole was asleep when a yellow orb flew into the ninja's quarters. The sudden appearance of the orb roused Cole from his sleep, prompting him to pursue it outside. Although he had encountered the orb on previous occasions, he was unable to identify it, leaving him to ponder its nature once again. Cole expressed to the orb his current lack of powers, stating that if he were able, he would create an earth bridge to follow it. In response, the orb illuminated a path through the fog, revealing the existence of another monastery nearby.

The Sword Shatters[]

Lloyd woke everybody up for training. Later Cole told Zane about the mysterious monastery the yellow orb showed him last night. Zane suggested that instead of wondering why he was guided to that monastery, he think about how can he get there. Walking into their quarters, they saw Arin doing some detective work. Cole was surprised that Ras had let Arin and Riyu go and expressed skepticism that Ras might not have been behind the attack on the Matriarch dragon. The group discussed the possible suspects, with Cole pointing out that Zeatrix was oddly confident about winning and suggested that she might know something about the horns. When Arin brought up the mysterious symbol he found, Cole suggested for Arin go to the Temple City Museum, as it contained all kinds of ancient art and writing. As Arin left, Cole noticed his cold demeanor towards Sora, which Zane commented as registering with high levels of cringe.

At the Games Plaza, Sora asked Lloyd, Zane and Cole where Riyu went. Cole said he probably went with Nya when he got distracted by the food. When Roby announced that Frak and Zur will be the next competitors, Frak turned to Cole, curious about his newfound Earth powers. In response, Cole offered some advice, specifically suggesting for Frak to focus on reaching down instead of up, a different motion than using his Quake ability. Sora, having overheard, questioned Cole as to why he was helping Frak, given that the latter was on Ras' team. In response, Cole reminded her that they couldn't let their history with Ras interfere with their decisions.

With the bell rung by Bleckt, the match began. When Zur froze Frak in place and began to sink him down, Cole’s voice rang out, reminding Frak to tap into his Earth power like they’d discussed. Frak followed the advice and successfully used the power to lift himself back up, ultimately defeating Zur. Roby then transfered Zur's Elemental Powers to Frak, signaling his victory. From the sidelines, Ras reprimanded Frak for taking advice from Cole, angrily growling that only he was Frak's master and no one else. Cole, who had been watching from a distance, gave Frak a sympathetic glance.
